page.content:
The principate and dominate from Augustus through late antiquity.

How Roman Empire connects

  • Character: Augustus — Augustus founded the principate that became the Empire.
  • Topic: Ancient Rome — The Empire is Rome after Augustus monopolized power.
  • Faction: Roman Republic — The Republic preceded and was transformed into the Empire.
  • Character: Constantine — Constantine remade the late empire as a Christian monarchy.
  • Faction: Roman legion — The standing legion was the Empire's occupation force.
  • Location: Colosseum — The Colosseum is an imperial monument of the Flavian city.
  • Character: Nero — Nero ruled as a Julio-Claudian emperor of Rome.

What is Roman Empire?

The Roman Empire is the autocracy Augustus built on Republican forms: provinces, standing legions, imperial cult, and, after crisis, Constantine's Christian monarchy.

Key threads lead to Augustus, Ancient Rome, Roman Republic, Constantine, Roman legion and Colosseum.
